name: Germany Heritage
notes: Designed via the per-theme design card (Phase 0b), deliberately apolitical: dark carved-oak Gothic lancet arch, oak-and-linden knotwork rails, carved sunburst rosette crown, Rhine castle + Fachwerk market-well vignettes, plain oak-tree shield (no crown, no eagle, no cross, no flag colors). Built from diffui option germany-v2-a. Canonical box 900x1500 (skinnier house default). Same slot-detection and silhouette fixes as england-heritage.
